titles.title: It Was Blue and Green

credit_line: Whitney Museum of American Art, New York; Lawrence H. Bloedel Bequest
description: An uneven band of blue arches into the composition from the left side, forming a sideways U-shape. Blue and green tendrils emerge from the blue band like tributaries diverging from a river. These elements appear to float in a hazy blue, white, and green background.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Whitney Museum of American Art.
title: It Was Blue and Green
